name: Bikash Chetry
bio: Bikash Chetry is an Assamese YouTuber and travel creator known for motorcycle travel vlogs and food content. Every booking request is coordinated by our team with the artist’s authorised representative, subject to their availability.

Podcast microphone — illustrative photo

faqs.q: Why is the fee “on request”?
faqs.a: Fees depend on date, city, duration, travel and production needs, and are confirmed with the authorised representative before we send you a quote.

faqs.q: How fast will I hear back?
faqs.a: Our team checks availability with the representative and usually responds within 24 hours on working days.

faqs.q: Is my booking confirmed once I send a request?
faqs.a: Not yet. Every request is subject to the artist’s availability and their team’s approval. Nothing is confirmed until the contract is signed and the advance is paid.
